1479-5621-8337.description:
Play Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it, M'Ress, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the M'Ress trigger, creating two 1/1 red Officer creature tokens
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and M'Ress trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

5078-5741-7296-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2178-2380-5256.easyPrerequisites:
Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage doesn't have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff is attached to Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage.
2178-2380-5256.description:
Activate Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage by tapping it, creating a creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage triggers due to its ability granted to it by Thornbite Staff, untapping Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill card(s)
Repeat.

728-2169-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
728-2169-4694-7306.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {U}{G}, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, untapping it and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1477-2146-5131--202.easyPrerequisites:
Cloud Key has "Artifact" chosen.
You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-1477-2146-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Cloud Key.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature
Repeat.

2511-6012--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2511-6012--5--195.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Reluctant Role Model trigger.
Resolve Reluctant Role Model's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2557-4772-5478-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
2557-4772-5478-6753-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

5147-5621-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Arid Archway.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Arid Archway from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Arid Archway enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Repeat.

215-6984-7781.notablePrerequisites:
Evendo has at least twelve charge counters on it.
You control seven or more creatures.
215-6984-7781.description:
Activate Evendo, Waking Haven by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least seven {G}.
Cast Woodcaller Automaton for its prototype cost by paying {2}{G}{G}.
When Woodcaller Automaton enters, it triggers, causing Evendo, Waking Haven to become a creature and untapping it.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Woodcaller Automaton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

969-1368-5477-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
969-1368-5477-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

413-5571-7666--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
When the undying creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 2
Repeat from step 2.

891-997-2961.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, False Demise triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Repeat.

5147-6972-7228.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two instant and/or sorcery cards in all graveyards.
5147-6972-7228.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Academy Elite.
When Academy Elite dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

1734-2150-2438.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Hero of the Dunes from exile to the battlefield.
When Hero of the Dunes enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4659-6972-7159.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Arcbound Tracker.
When Arcbound Tracker dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Tracker's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Tracker from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4019-6073-6972.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Vigean Graftmage.
4019-6073-6972.description:
Kill Vigean Graftmage.
When Vigean Graftmage dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its graft ability.
When Vigean Graftmage enters, Angelic Sell-Sword triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Vigean Graftmage triggers, moving a +1/+1 counter from it to the creature token. Vigean Graftmage dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Repeat from step 2.

1268-3043.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures with defender.
1268-3043.description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Crab Umbra by paying {2}{U}, untapping Axebane Guardian.
Repeat.

3705-4050-5687-6896.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
Repeat.

460-539-850.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with defender.
460-539-850.description:
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Scryb Ranger by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Overgrown Battlement.
Cast Scryb Ranger by paying {1}{G}.
Repeat.

Activate Atog by sacrificing another artifact, which is a Food due to Ragost.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

855-1491-4474-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

1617-4831-4983-5358-6558.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
Naga Fleshcrafter on the battlefield as a copy of Bellowing Aegisaur.
1617-4831-4983-5358-6558.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur to fight each other, with each only taking 1 damage due to Temple Altisaur.
Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur trigger twice.
Resolve both Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping the mana-producing permanent and Wayta.
Repeat from step 2, alternating between having Cacophodon fight Bellowing Aegisaur and Naga Fleshcrafter to ensure neither dies due to lethal damage.

851-1115-1563-2457.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

1887-2583-3334-5870.description:
Activate Whirler Virtuoso by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E} and gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1069-1849-5285-5499.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
Luminarch Ascension has at least four quest counters on it.
1069-1849-5285-5499.description:
Activate Luminarch Ascension by paying {1}{W}, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Angel.
Activate the Angel by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Angels.

2281-2292-2757-5006.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one basic Forest.
You control at least one basic Plains.
2281-2292-2757-5006.description:
Activate a basic Forest and Plains by tapping them, adding {G}{W}.
Activate Earthcraft twice by tapping Lurrus and Saffi, untapping the basic Forest and Plains.
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Lurrus.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Lurrus.
When Lurrus dies, Saffi triggers, returning Lurrus from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Saffi from your graveyard by paying {G}{W}.
Repeat.

1233-3259-4068.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control at least one Mountain.
1233-3259-4068.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Squee as attackers.
Squee triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

800-2092-4949.notablePrerequisites:
Knacksaw Clique does not have summoning sickness.
Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 1 or greater.
800-2092-4949.description:
Activate Knacksaw Clique by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Knacksaw Clique by paying {U} and untapping it, exiling the top card of an opponent's library with the ability to cast that card this turn.
Repeat.

2269-3924-4050-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Deep Forest Hermit, adding {G}.
Deep Forest Hermit dies, triggering Mortuary, putting Deep Forest Hermit on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Call of the Wild by paying {2}{G}{G}, revealing Deep Forest Hermit from the top of your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Deep Forest Hermit enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Squirrel tokens, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Call of the Wild's ability to put all creature cards from your library onto the battlefield.

1437-2743.notablePrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least one indestructible counter on it.
1437-2743.description:
Cast Biovisionary by paying {1}{U}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Biovisionary spell three times.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.
